inputs.original_text: US-Israel-Iran War Amid escalating Middle East tensions the US proposed a 15-point ceasefire plan to Iran via Pakistan Iran however presented five counter-conditions seeking an end to aggression compensation and recognition of Strait of Hormuz sovereignty Israel remains sceptical of Irans acceptance and emphasises its right to pre-emptive strikes highlighting the complex demands from all sides to end the ongoing conflict
inputs.modified_text:
Open your eyes to what they aren't telling you. This whole so-called US-Israel-Iran War is nothing more than a scripted theater designed to hoodwink the public. We are expected to believe the official narrative about a US-proposed 15-point ceasefire plan delivered to Iran via Pakistan, but it is all a smokescreen for the real puppet masters pulling the strings behind the scenes. 

When Iran supposedly presented five counter-conditions seeking an end to aggression compensation and recognition of Strait of Hormuz sovereignty, they were just playing their assigned roles in this grand deception. And don't fall for Israel remaining sceptical of Irans acceptance and emphasises its right to pre-emptive strikes—that manufactured friction is carefully calibrated to keep the populations terrified and compliant while the elite advance their hidden agenda. Every demand and every rejection is completely coordinated from the top down.
